title: Mark grows from a dot, slides open a phrase, hides it
summary: On black, a glowing mark grows from a dot at centre, glides left, then whips right and drags a short phrase out from behind its edge. It slides back over the phrase to swallow it and settles left, dimmed. One object does every move.
use_when: A 4 s logo sting or bumper with a mark and one short line
Opening or closing a dark film with the brand mark as the only actor
A mark with a strong silhouette that reads at 10 % of frame width
Silent autoplay where one motion idea must carry the brand

look.type_style: bold grotesk, title case, normal tracking, cap height ~6 % H, one line of 3 words, white with a soft halo

sfx.event: mark grows from the dot to full size
mark slides back over the phrase

structure.shot: black frame; a dot appears at centre and grows into the mark, ~3 % to ~10 % of frame width, glow halo rising with it
structure.camera: locked frame, no global move; growth is the mark's own scale
structure.motion: empty 0.00-0.27; dot at 0.27 (~3 % W); scale up 22 fr (±0.25 s), slow to 0.77 then fast to full at 1.00, springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable); halo fades in with the scale

structure.shot: the mark alone, glowing at centre, then glides to the left third and stops
structure.camera: locked frame; the mark travels ~27 % of width left on a shallow downward arc
structure.motion: hold 1.00-1.27 (8 fr); glide left 22 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutSine, path dips ~9 % H at 1.77 and returns, ~7 deg tilt mid-move, motion blur on the fast frames; settled at 2.00, holds to 2.27

structure.shot: mark whips to the right of centre; a 3-word phrase is pulled out from behind its left edge and sits centred, mark beside it
structure.motion: mark travels ~57 % of width right in 15 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outExpo, heavy motion blur at 2.50; phrase clipped by a mask whose edge follows the mark, fully shown at 2.77; mark settles springs.snappy (~6 % overshoot read at 3.00, ±0.25 s); phrase holds still 2.77-3.27

structure.shot: mark slides back left over the phrase, which disappears behind its edge; mark ends alone at the left third, dimmed
structure.motion: mark travels ~57 % of width left in 22 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inOutSine, motion blur at 3.50; phrase hidden by the same mask from its right end; glow fades and mark drops to ~60 % brightness 3.77-4.00; hold to end

params.brand: any brand.json: the mark (needs a solid silhouette), display font, fg, bg (dark)
params.content.phrase: one tagline line, 2-4 words, fits in ~45 % of frame width at 6 % H cap height
params.timing.growFrames: frames for dot to full mark (default 22)
params.timing.revealFrames: frames of the right whip that reveals the phrase (default 15)
params.timing.hideFrames: frames of the return slide that hides it (default 22)
params.glow: halo strength under the mark and phrase (default soft white)

notes: Single shot, no cuts, silent reference; all times read from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Mark size is constant (~10 % W, ~18 % H) after 1.00. The phrase never moves: only the mask edge travels with the mark. Glow sits under the mark, never additive on top. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term (recipe.md only): mark-carried mask, a text mask whose edge is the moving mark. Palette sampled from keyframes 1.50 and 3.50 (no cut frames).
